items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one standalone fantasy faction hanging banner for the existing Kalistar card universe, transparent background. Reference image is ONLY for the physical craftsmanship, restrained metallic heraldic construction and painterly finish; DO NOT reproduce its white/blue color, crown emblem, thin icicle silhouette or text. Create the NEW Grivka faction banner for an intelligent human-wolf hybrid people living in snowy tundra/mountains of Niveria. A broad compact charcoal woven wool hanging standard with two short sharply split tails, a muted oxblood/garnet inner fabric panel and weathered silver hem. Bold, clean, original silver frontal wolf-head heraldic emblem, intelligent narrow eyes, not a snarling monster, above one small angular mountain notch. This emblem must read at tiny card size. Top attached to a short aged silver rod with two small geometric fang-shaped terminals, no human skulls, no crown, no moon. One coherent tactile object, front facing, symmetrical, a few natural cloth folds, no many tiny ornaments. Same premium painted material grain as a Kalistar card prop, not vector art, not photoreal 3D. Center fully visible with generous transparent margins. No lettering, name, words, runes, card frame or background scene. Truly transparent alpha.
items.note: Heraldic design proposal. Not a calibrated native banner export.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: standalone Kalistar character illustration PROPOSAL, not a card. Output one vertical portrait roughly 4:5 suited to a 737x921 illustration window. Input images 1 Momo and 2 Valazar are mandatory PAINTERLY ART DIRECTION references only: same coarse yet carefully controlled painted material facets, visible angular brushwork, worn fabrics and metal, expressive narrative face, high visual legibility. They are not subject or setting references. Image 3 is the exact proposed GRIVKA faction heraldry: charcoal and garnet textile, silver frontal wolf head and small mountain sign. If insignia visible reproduce this emblem, never the white-and-blue Ysilis crown. WORLD: Niveria is a REGION of ice, tundra and mountains; Grivka is this Okami people's faction, NOT Ysilis human kingdom. Okami are the harmonious permanent fusion of human and wolf, not humans wearing pelts, not humans with decorative wolf ears, not monstrous hulking werewolves: upright naturally proportioned human torso/limbs, refined unmistakable wolf head with muzzle, expressive intelligent eyes, alert ears, fine fur, dexterous five-finger humanoid hands. One head, exactly two arms and two legs. Clothes stay Kalistar's handmade winter cloth/leather/metal, only weapon engineering has a subtle advanced post-apocalyptic character. No modern military tactical suit. Background restrained, broad readable snowy planes, NO busy city, NO random ruins, no forest of flags, no dense particles. No text, numbers, watermark, frame, UI, statistics. Avoid photorealism, smooth CGI, anime, cartoon, erotic costuming, all-over noisy texture or generic snarling pose. Preserve central face, main gesture and weapon away from edges.
SUBJECT RHOVAN, a mature male Okami keeper of mountain passes, strong but lean normal humanoid anatomy, ash-grey wolf fur with white muzzle and a subtle nick in one ear, tired amber eyes, mouth closed. Deep charcoal long winter coat with carefully tailored overlapping wool panels, muted garnet lining and sash, worn leather belt and greaves, aged silver fasteners; a small Grivka emblem worn on breast clasp. SCENE AND EMOTION: he has stopped on a broad snow-covered stone step beside a simple mountain refuge doorway; one hand lifts an old rescue carabiner from the rope at his belt and he looks at it with restrained tenderness, a private memory of a person he once saved. His other hand naturally holds a LONG STRAIGHT trekking-spear planted on the same ground beside him, all shafts and blade in one coherent axis, slightly advanced segmented dark steel shaft, a striking asymmetric forged silver ice-cutting spearhead with a thin contained pale cyan energy channel, not giant neon. Full figure in three-quarter profile, grounded boots and hands clearly understandable; do not bend the shaft to fit; tip may leave the frame. Only an indistinct mountain ridge and a wide quiet snow valley beyond him. Late afternoon cool daylight with small warm reflected light from doorway on muzzle and clasp. A composed intelligent person with a vocation and history, not an aggressive monster. Rich colored painterly strokes matching Momo, not flat grey or blurry. No other characters. No banner in background; small exact heraldic clasp only.

SUBJECT EYSKA, an adult female Okami route-finder of Grivka, athletic and slender in entirely practical layered winter clothes, russet-grey wolf fur fading to ivory around short refined muzzle, dark expressive hazel eyes and distinctive dark ear tips. Humanlike proportional shoulders and arms, NOT sexualized, NOT cartoon. Short tailored dark charcoal wool coat, muted garnet woven waist wrap, reinforced split skirt panels over warm fitted trousers, aged silver articulated elbow/shoulder pieces, climbing boots and practical leather gloves exposing furred fingers. Small exact Grivka wolf/mountain insignia at shoulder clasp. SCENE AND EMOTION: lower viewpoint close enough to read her face, her body is turned sideways as she kneels on one knee on a broad frozen lake margin and brushes powder snow off a rope trail marker half buried in ice. She turns her head back with a lively, relieved, quietly proud expression: the lost mountain route still exists. With her other hand she steadies a beautifully crafted compact archer's bow against her raised thigh; unusual recovered silver-metal openwork bow riser, dark limbs, extremely restrained cyan Kalistel light at its core, physically plausible continuous bow limbs and taut straight bowstring, no impossible loops, coherent hand grip. One slim arrow case at hip. The main moment is tactile discovery and intelligence, not combat. Cool clean winter morning, warm low side sun catches muzzle and fingers. Simple broad ice/snow foreground, a SINGLE remote broad mountain silhouette under pale sky, distant valley rendered in few brush planes. No giant structures, no busy forest, no armies. New composition different from RHOVAN: intimate dynamic crouch with diagonal torso, not standing with staff. Central face and hands, three-quarter body clearly framed with room for later card crop. No other characters, no background banner.
